text_en: Hong Kong-listed mainland property stocks rallied broadly, with Ronshine China surging nearly 12%, Country Garden up nearly 8%, Shimao Group up nearly 9%, Agile Group up 7%, Sunac China up over 5%, Jinhui Holdings up 4.6%, Sino-Ocean Group up 4%, with China Jinmao, China Overseas Grand Oceans, Longfor Group, Yuexiu Property, and Xincheng Development following gains. News-wise, today's gains were mainly boosted by Beijing's latest property policy released on the evening of August 7. The new policy, jointly issued by three departments, effective August 8, 2026, covers home purchase limits, gifting, and housing provident funds. Purchase limits significantly relaxed: non-Beijing households buying homes within the 5th Ring Road see social security or tax payment requirements cut from 2 years to 1 year; outside the 5th Ring Road, no home purchase limits.
